laws.rule: Sergipe state Lei 9.729/2025 bans burning, letting off, selling, storing and transporting loud-bang fireworks across the state, as reported by the state legislature. An amendment keeps interstate trade for registered and authorised companies. Lei 9.750/2025 separately bans fireworks and similar pyrotechnic devices inside enclosed entertainment venues such as nightclubs and theatres.
laws.penalty_signal: Lei 9.750 fine of 1,000 UFP/SE per the legislature's news (UFP/SE is the state fiscal unit); Lei 9.729 penalty not read
